messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: KV-cache continuous-batch anomaly detected on cluster eu-west-1. Affected model family: mistral-gqa and qwen-mqa variants. Metric: prefix-cardinality spiked, kv-eviction-rate > 98% in 3m. Trigger rule: kv.eviction_rate > 80% && contbatch.pending > 3000
priya (eng-oncall): I'm on it. grabbing graphs now. suspected continuous-batching growth + misaligned prefetch window.
samir: which shards/nodes? any correlation with a rollout?
megan: graph: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv/contbatch?panelId=7 (watch 10:12-10:22) — eviction and batch-size both climbing, tail latency for generate tokens jumping to 3x.
ops-pager: customer impact: CS reports multiple enterprise customers seeing timeouts on streaming responses and degraded completeness on long-context completions.
ben (platform): no recent infra deploys in the last hour. model rollout?
megan: we pushed qwen-mqa-v2 to canary ~09:40 but traffic % is small. metric shows MQA traffic amplifies contbatch growth because of long prefix reuse patterns.
priya (eng-oncall): ok plan: 1) throttle continuous batching and prefetch for MQA/GQA group 2) fallback heavy requests to llama-compatible variant 3) notify CS 4) monitor. I'll do 1 and 2.
samir: how do we throttle quickly? config path?
priya (eng-oncall): patching runtime config: ```
# reduce contbatch window and disable aggressive prefetch for model tags
redwoodctl runtime update --selector "model_family in (qwen-mqa,mistral-gqa)" \ 
  --set contbatch.enabled=true --set contbatch.max_window=64 --set contbatch.max_pending=500 --set prefetch.enabled=false
```
megan: push it. also drop default batch target from 256->128 for those selectors.
priya (eng-oncall): applied patch: rollout id r-8f3a2c. new params should hit nodes in ~35s.
incident-bot: rollout r-8f3a2c: started by priya. 120 pods targeted. health checks: 0/120 updated.
ops-pager: seeing initial lowering of pending count, eviction rate down from 98% -> 65% in 2m. tail latency improving.
ben (platform): still seeing a subset of nodes with high KV miss amplification — probable hot prefixes with high cardinality. can we evict specific prefix buckets?
priya (eng-oncall): yes, targeted eviction: ```
redwoodctl kv flush --model-selector "model_family in (qwen-mqa)" --prefix-match "user:prompt:*" --dry-run=false
```
samir: careful — flushing will increase backend compute temporarily; run during rate window.
megan: running flush on canary shard set first.
incident-bot: action log: flush job j-342 kicked. progress: 16/40 shards success.
customer-support: notifying affected enterprise customers now with status update (we flagged potential degraded streaming & elevated latency; mitigation underway).
ops-pager: metrics: 95th token latency for qwen-mqa dropped from 2.8s -> 0.9s after the throttle and flush. some customers report resumed streams.
priya (eng-oncall): good. still seeing a small oscillation tied to continuous-batch refill loops on one AZ. I'm spinning down prefetch workers for that AZ.
megan: confirm prefetch workers disabled in eu-west-1a.
priya (eng-oncall): done. monitoring.
ben (platform): setting temporary routing policy: prefer-dedicated -> route MQA traffic to dedicated capacity pool with conservative batching. ```
redwoodctl routing update --policy prefer-dedicated --selector "model_family in (qwen-mqa,mistral-gqa)" --priority 900
```
samir: @priya I'll take oncall in 30m. can you summarize what to watch and any rollback commands?
priya (eng-oncall): handing off to @samir in 30m. watch keys: kv.eviction_rate, contbatch.pending, generate.token_95th. Rollback: ```
# rollback runtime params
redwoodctl rollout cancel r-8f3a2c || redwoodctl runtime update --selector "model_family in (qwen-mqa,mistral-gqa)" --set contbatch.max_window=256 --set prefetch.enabled=true
```
priya (eng-oncall): also if tail latency creeps back, immediately route MQA->llama fallback: ```
redwoodctl routing update --selector "model_family in (qwen-mqa)" --fallback-model "llama-13b-compat" --threshold 0.75
```
customer-support: we've sent proactive emails to 6 customers and created ticket batch #CS-7741.
incident-bot: postmortem placeholder created: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/2612345678-prefetch-edgecase-gqa-mqa-qwen-handoff — assigned to priya, due EOD.
samir: thanks — I'll continue monitoring and coordinate follow-ups. leaving a note for post-incident action items: 1) add canary checks for contbatch growth patterns 2) add limiters per-prefix cardinality 3) refine prefetch heuristics for MQA/GQA 4) test fallback routing in chaos runs.
megan: capturing relevant traces and perf profiles to attach to postmortem.
priya (eng-oncall): handing over now. if anything spikes again, @samir page immediately. closing thread for now but will update postmortem when we have root cause. :white_check_mark:
